reviews.text: if I could give this cream 100 stars instead of 5 I would gladly do so , my skin has broken out with everything for a few years until I tried the elizavecca creams , I used the pink little cute pig tub years and years ago I never even knew what Korean skincare was this is like a looong time ago I think it was called sparkle cream it was really good but since I started to dislike niacinimide i was on the lookout for a niacinimide free Korean cream when I stumbled back on to good old elizavecca and I am so happy I bought this because it has my skin so beautiful and glowing and hydrated without being to heavy or greasy it’s such a perfect day and night cream I’d say it’s great for all skin types I would highly recommend if your having skin breakouts or oiliness or dryness it seems to do it all and even out skin beautifully
reviews.zh: 如果可以俾呢款面霜一百粒星而唔係五粒，我都會好願意噉俾。我嘅皮膚幾年嚟一直都爆痘，直至我試咗 elizavecca 嘅面霜。我好多好多年前用過粉紅色、細細隻嘅可愛豬豬罐，當時我唔知咩叫韓國護膚。呢個已經好耐以前嘅事，我諗嗰款叫 sparkle cream，真係好好用。不過自從我開始唔鍾意煙醯胺（niacinamide）之後，我一直留意無煙醯胺嘅韓國面霜。然後我再次搵返親愛嘅 elizavecca，我好高興買咗呢款，因為佢令我嘅皮膚好靚、好水潤、保濕，又唔會太厚或者油膩。佢真係日夜都好啱用，我會話佢啱所有膚質。如果你皮膚爆痘、出油或者乾燥，我都強烈推薦，佢似乎都可以處理到，而且令膚色均勻好多。

reviews.text: Adoro il brand del quale ho acquistato e acquisto regolarmente diversi prodotti. Questa crema è il peggiore prodotto che ho acquistato, onestamente non ho riscontrato nessun effetto negativo ma nemmeno benefico. Sembra di spalmare il nulla. Non la ricomprerò
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個品牌，而且定期買佢哋嘅多款產品。但係呢款面霜係我買過最差嘅產品。老實講，我冇感覺到任何負面效果，但都冇咩正面效果。塗落好似塗咗等於冇嘢咁。我唔會再買。

reviews.text: mi sono trova bene con molti prodotti di questo brand ma con questa crema non tanto . la consistenza è buona ma c'è qualcosa che mi irrita un po' la pelle quindi non so esprimere un giudizio completo .
reviews.zh: 我用呢個品牌嘅好多產品都幾好，但係呢款面霜就唔係咁好。質地幾好，但係有啲嘢令我皮膚有少少刺激，所以我未能俾一個完整嘅評價。

reviews.text: ha la consistenza di un burrocacao, può andar bene se si ha la pelle molto molto secca ed in pieno inverno sulla neve. la sconsiglio.
reviews.zh: 佢個質地似潤唇膏，如果皮膚非常非常乾，又或者係冬天落雪嗰陣，可能會啱用。我唔建議。

reviews.text:
Esta crema me ha encantado, va a ser un básico en mi rutina, pero no para mi rutina diaria, pero si es perfecta para mis épocas de deshidratación.
Hay que recalcar que no es una crema para todo el mundo, es una crema para pieles secas y deshidratadas, excesiva para otro tipo de pieles. Y a esto le tienes que sumar que te tienen que gustar las texturas densas, tipo manteca... 
Con muy poco producto te va a sobrar y deja la piel muy hidratada y jugosa.
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意呢款面霜，會成為我嘅基本款，但唔係日常每日用，而係啱我皮膚脫水嗰段時間用。要強調，呢款唔係啱所有人，佢係為乾燥同脫水皮膚而設，對其他膚質嚟講太濃。除咗呢點，你仲要鍾意濃稠、似牛油嘅質地……
用少少就已經足夠，仲會剩低，皮膚會好滋潤、水嫩。

reviews.text: Esta crema de noche es muy nutritiva y me ha gustado mucho, ya que es perfecta para pieles secas.
reviews.zh: 呢款晚霜好有營養，我好鍾意，因為好啱乾性皮膚。

reviews.text: The texture of this cream feels surprisingly fluffy and on my dry skin it feels nice, moisturizing, but not greasy. I think it is especially good in summer, when I need lighter creams than in winter.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜嘅質地出奇地蓬鬆，塗喺我嘅乾性皮膚上感覺好舒服、滋潤，但唔油膩。我覺得夏天特別好，因為夏天我需要比冬天更輕身嘅面霜。

reviews.text: I must say this leaves my face feeling so soft. However I have quite oily skin and this just makes it worse so I would avoid it if you have oily skin but if you have normal to dry skin this would be perfect!
reviews.zh: 我一定要講，呢款令我面好軟滑。不過我嘅皮膚都幾油，呢款只會令情況更差，所以如果你係油性皮膚就唔好用；但如果你係中性至乾性皮膚，呢款就啱晒！
